newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Chemical Industries buys London properties.
newsitem.headline: Chemical Industries buys London properties.

text.p: Chemical Industries Far East Ltd said on Monday it purchased three properties in London for 17.18 million sterling (US$28.5 million).
The purchases were part of its activities in investment and trading of property in London.

The company bought a six-storey freehold office block for eight million sterling, another six-storey office building suitable for conversion into residential and retail units for 2.83 million sterling, and a commercial building for 6.35 million sterling.
All purchases are being funded by internal sources and bank borrowings, the company said.
